crash_investigation.recorded_signature_is_wrong: The Side-in stage's one crash is recorded as 'exit44330098: See the migration guide...'. That is a bug in soak.py at run time: a loop variable named code overwrote the exit status, and the signature fell back to a benign Gym warning. Both are fixed after the run. The kernel log gives the true cause: SIGSEGV in ygopro_ygoenv.cpython-310-x86_64-linux-gnu.so at file offset 0x327f5b, at 02:47:39 UTC, matching the batch log's last write. The fixed soak records later crashes as 'exit-11'.
crash_investigation.fault: The faulting instruction reads the next pointer in a loop that frees a list of objects, up to an object embedded at offset 0x588 of its parent. The surrounding code matches Lua's luaC_freeallobjects (gcstp set to 4, white-bit masks 0x18): deletelist over allgc during lua_close. The module is stripped, so this is read from the machine code, not a symbol. In production the duel's Lua state closes in _duel_end, when the duel is won. A freed or corrupted object on that list means memory was damaged earlier in the duel.
crash_investigation.duel: Side-in stage seed 88264285, fl41606 (Hero Frog, EWCQ07) against fl41081 (Neo-Spacian Diva Hero, BCS16), uniform random play. It died on the 241st decision, a lethal direct attack.
crash_investigation.replays: The same duel replays with an identical decision trace every time, and the 5 duels before it in its batch match their recorded traces. Run alone one at a time it crashed in 2 of 15 runs: 0 of 7 normally or with malloc perturbation, 2 of 8 with address randomization off. With 12 runs in parallel it crashed in 7 of 96 alone and 6 of 96 inside its batch. The rest of that batch, run without it, crashed in 0 of 192 runs. One crashing replay died at decision 124 in libc instead, right after Neo-Spacian Dark Panther chose Treeborn Frog as its target. So the damage depends on this game's path, and whether it shows depends on memory layout.
crash_investigation.pair_probes: The same two lists, fresh seeds: Main and Extra 1 crash in 6,000 duels (88510000-88515999, same fault offset, eager play, died on a decision after Gorz attacked); Side-in 0 in 6,000 (88500000-88505999). The Main and Extra probe ran before the fix, so its crash is also recorded with a wrong exit status (exit73146473); the kernel log shows SIGSEGV at the same offset.
crash_investigation.dark_panther_lead: Neo-Spacian Dark Panther is the lead, not a confirmed cause. All 6 crash duels used its copy effect, 2 to 74 times. In the pair probe's crash one player activated it 52 times in 60 consecutive decisions, all their own. One once-per-turn effect should not allow that unless each activation gains a fresh copy of the effect, which deserves its own rules check. Played 24,000 times each, the original pair crashed 4 times (88700000-88723999, all SIGSEGV in the module, 3 at offset 0x327f5b and 1 at 0x32569e) and the pair with fl41081's 3 Dark Panther replaced by Gene-Warped Warwolf crashed 0 times (88730000-88753999). A 4 to 0 split has probability 1 in 16 if the rates were equal. Decks generated around Dark Panther, Treeborn Frog, Elemental HERO Ocean, Armory Arm and Future Fusion crashed 0 times in 3,000 duels each (88600000-88614999).
crash_investigation.attribution_rule: The report's per-crash card is the last card chosen, here Elemental HERO Gaia's lethal attack. It is not the cause.
